**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

The forest ranger always / treats all the wild animals / in his area very kindly.
solution:
The correct answer is "No error". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence you provided is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• It is grammatically sound and conveys a clear meaning.
 
• **"Always"** is an adverb that is typically used before the main verb in a sentence. 
 
 
• **Example**: *He **always completes**__ his homework.*
